2026-08-08 THE RUN'S CENTRAL FINDING: cost is the payoff of a build-it-cheap talk. Peckham Industries put an itemised ~$3,000/yr slide (tokens $19.70, vector store $840, Azure App Service $2,760) in front of an AGC conference room precisely because the punchline was 'we built this for three thousand dollars and we are not data scientists' - and that same fact fails them on filter 3. A company that BOUGHT from a vendor has an NDA or simply no reason to put the price on the slide. Our filter requires BOTH a disclosed cost AND a bought-not-built solution, and in published sources that intersection is close to empty. This needs a maintainer decision, not another scout.

2026-08-08 kills worth remembering: Summit Electric killed independently by two scouts (built in house, plus a Sonepar operating company); Dairyland Power builds and resells its platform so it is a vendor here, not an adopter; Casella Construction's deck has real numbers and no AI in it at all; 'Meridian Supply Co.' is an almost-certainly synthetic vendor case study and must never be used; one quoted 'independent customer' turned out to be the vendor's own COO.

2026-08-08 vendor stat-card check earned its place: the Field Aerospace page's stat card reads '25 minutes (vs 3-4 weeks before)' while the body prose and the named human's pull quote both say two weeks. A marketer appears to have collapsed 'three or four people, two weeks' into '3-4 weeks'. Shipping the card would have inflated the baseline ~2x on a vendor's arithmetic error.

2026-08-08 PDF tooling: poppler is NOT installed in this sandbox, so a subagent without Bash has no local PDF path. r.jina.ai works but has a rate quota that recovers in ~15 minutes, so a 401 means wait rather than blocked. Image-only decks return nothing and are a dead end, not a retry.

Wave 1 recorded losing achrnews.com as 'severe' and half of that was a tool artefact. Genuinely walled to everything by Cloudflare JS challenge: bizjournals.com, forconstructionpros.com, thefabricator.com, sdcexec.com, naw.org.
